title: SN360-ES Test Email
description: Canonical schema for synthetic test emails consumed by the SN360-ES evaluation harness. The 16 categories and 6 tiers are the same vocabulary used at runtime by internal/constant/categories.go (Category.Valid / Category.IsBenign / Category.IsHighSeverity) and internal/constant/tiers.go (Tier.Valid). Score ranges match internal/config/config.go ScoreThresholds defaults. Tier 1 verdict expectations match internal/service/tier1/config.go DefaultThresholds (pass<20, escalate 20-60, flag>60).

category.description: One of the 16 categories from internal/constant/categories.go AllCategories.

expected_tier.description: Final user-facing tier expected from the full pipeline. From internal/constant/tiers.go AllTiers.

expected_score_range.description: [low, high] inclusive bounds for the final risk score. Must align with tier thresholds: Blocked 85-100, HighRisk 70-84, Warning 50-69, Caution 30-49, Informational 15-29, Trusted 0-14.

is_threat.description: true for malicious emails, false for benign emails (regardless of category).

difficulty.description: Signal density. 'easy' has overt cues; 'medium' has mixed signals; 'hard' is adversarial / subtle.

locale.description: Primary natural-language locale of subject/body. ISO 639-1 codes supported by the SN360-ES i18n catalogs.

attack_type.description: Short human-readable label for the attack technique (e.g. 'CEO wire-transfer impersonation', 'Punycode lookalike of microsoft.com').

description.description: One-sentence summary of what this test validates.

expected_signals.description: Detection signal names the pipeline should surface (e.g. 'URGENT_TONE', 'REPLY_TO_MISMATCH', 'PUNYCODE_DOMAIN'). PII-free.

tier0_bypass.description: When true, Tier 0 (rule-based classification gate) should short-circuit and skip Tier 1/2 entirely (e.g. INTERNAL_TRUSTED, VENDOR_TRUSTED, benign NEWSLETTER).

expected_tier1_verdict.description: Expected output of the Tier 1 (XLM-RoBERTa encoder) threshold logic. Thresholds: pass < 20, escalate 20-60, flag > 60 (DefaultThresholds in internal/service/tier1/config.go). 'skip' is used when tier0_bypass is true.

expected_tier2_needed.description: Whether Tier 2 (Ternary-Bonsai-8B via kennguy3n/llama.cpp) should be invoked. Must be false whenever tier0_bypass is true OR expected_tier1_verdict == 'pass'.

expected_tier2_categories.description: Categories the Tier 2 LLM (Ternary-Bonsai-8B) should output. Required to be non-empty when expected_tier2_needed is true.

from_display.description: Display name component of the From header (may be spoofed for lookalike tests).

body_text.description: Plain-text body. Required even when body_html is also present.

body_html.description: Optional HTML body — used to test href/display mismatches, hidden text, etc.

headers.description: Additional RFC 5322 headers (e.g. Reply-To, Return-Path, Authentication-Results, List-Unsubscribe).
